Alarm mode is optional and used only for timed-session expiry alerts that you choose. Android requires full-screen notification access before MultiTimeTracker can show those alerts over the lock screen or another app.
Timed notifications need exact alarm access
MultiTimeTracker uses exact alarms only for timed sessions and alert timers you configure. Without this access, those local reminders may arrive late or only after you reopen the app.
MultiTimeTracker uses notifications only for your timed sessions, alert timers, and local reminders. It does not use remote push messages or ads.
